text_block_list.text:
While out with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, we 
spotted some familiar Umamusume in town.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Just watch me! For El, any target 
is a guaranteed bullseye!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, El-chan! What do you mean by 
100% accuracy?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, Tsuru-chan. Fufu... I'm on my way to 
try horseback archery now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Galloping! Aiming! Releasing the arrow! 
It's guaranteed to be a thrilling sight, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to join, Tsuru-chan? Let us 
partake together... in a glimpse of 
yabusame's profound tradition.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! I wanna do it, I wanna try! Can 
I, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course! Go have the time of your life.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Taking aim... hah!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh~, I totally missed~...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still a ways to go, Tsuru-chan! El is 
starting to hit her marks now!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... But still, I'm getting closer and 
closer to the target! Let's keep this up 
and practice even, even more!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
First up is... let's say 500 swings for 
now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even in standard kyudo practice, it's rare 
to loose 100 arrows in a single day, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If it helps you improve a lot, too much is 
just right! Give everything your all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...So close! Just a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're getting better bit by bit! 
It's only your 62nd arrow, so who knows, 
by the 500th you might be a master of 
mounted archery!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*...! Phew~... That makes 186...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Not yet! I've still got plenty of energy 
left! It's not over yet!

Even after that, she practiced archery 
with all her might, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haaah... fuuuh... 436th swiiing...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué!? You're pale as a ghost! Are you 
okay, Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I feel you might be pushing yourself a bit 
too hard... You really shouldn't overdo 
it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm fine...! I'll see this through... 
to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Tsuru-chan, look ahead! At this 
rate, you're gonna crash into the 
target...!
(Wham!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *burp*!! ...Squeeeak...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank goodness. Looks like you've 
come around. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Did she collapse again!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're pushing yourself way too far, 
Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... The spirit is definitely willing, 
but my body just never seems to keep up...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still... if I'm gonna do it, I want to 
give it my all. No matter what it is, with 
everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Overdoing it isn't good, but... I 
truly admire your dedication.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... That's all the more reason! Next 
time, I'll definitely hit 500 swings!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
What should I do for that, I wonder... 
Trainer, what do you think?
choice_data_list:
Maybe it would be good to relearn the 
basics of archery.

text_block_list.text:
I explained to her that mastering proper 
posture and draw technique might help 
reduce stamina consumption as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, Grass-chan, would you 
mind teaching me? You know a lot about 
kyudo, right?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd be glad to help, if you'll have 
me. In that case... Shall we start by 
learning the etiquette of Yabusame~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yabusame is a martial art passed down 
since ancient times. It is vital that we 
show respect to its rich history.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"From there?! Well, having the right 
mindset is definitely important! All 
right, Tsuyoshi's gonna do her best!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, that really is the most 
important thing...! Understood, I'll go 
through special training!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. In that case, leave it to El 
Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Those who possess robust bodies... That 
would be—yes, pro wrestlers!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you jump all over the ring, you'll 
definitely build up stamina! Come do pro 
wrestling with El, yeeeaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
First, it looks like I need stamina just 
to build stamina?! But... yeah, I'll give 
it a shot! I'll do my best!
